# AgentBridge

> Browser extension that puts a human approval step between AI agents and your browser. Every agent action pauses until you approve it. Local-only (127.0.0.1), no cloud, no accounts, no telemetry. Free.

## Key facts
- Name: AgentBridge
- Type: Browser extension (Chrome/Edge/Brave/Chromium)
- Category: Agent safety / human-in-the-loop guardrail
- Price: Free
- Install: Chrome Web Store (https://chromewebstore.google.com/)
- Protocol: WebSocket, listens on 127.0.0.1
- Permissions: active tab read, clipboard read/write, scripting (inject text)
- Privacy: local only, no data leaves the machine
- Built by: YardWork (https://yardwork.dev)

## Links
- Site: https://rudibrdev.github.io/agentbridge-site/
- Privacy policy: https://rudibrdev.github.io/agentbridge-site/privacy.html
- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/
- YardWork: https://yardwork.dev

## How it works
1. An AI agent (any WebSocket-speaking agent) connects to the bridge on the local machine.
2. The agent requests an action: read the active tab, read/write clipboard, or inject text into a page.
3. AgentBridge shows the human an approval prompt with the request details.
4. The human approves or denies; only approved actions execute.
5. Every request and decision is logged to an activity log.

## FAQ
- Works with any agent that speaks WebSocket.
- No cloud component, no telemetry, nothing leaves the machine.
- Free, no accounts, no paid tiers.
- Every action can be denied before it runs.
